questions.explanation: The Struve survey measured a long segment of a meridian. That helped establish Earth's dimensions and shape more accurately.

questions.prompt: At Finland's Kvarken Archipelago, which process is raising land and gradually isolating shallow bays as lakes?

choices.text: Volcanic uplift above an active mantle plume
Sediment compaction following rapid delta growth
Crustal shortening where two plates converge
Isostatic rebound after the removal of an ice sheet

questions.hint: Consider the load once borne by this landscape during the last ice age.
questions.explanation: The crust is still rising after the weight of glacial ice was removed. At Kvarken, this emergence exposes new land and can cut bays off from the sea.
